job.title: Polarn O.Pyret söker Digital Commerce & Customer Experience Lead

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Digital Commerce & Platform Integration | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and integrating enterprise digital platforms, PIM and ERP systems for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong background in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, data flows, solution design and AI-assisted delivery. Proven track record in aligning business needs with scalable technical solutions, optimizing performance and collaborating across international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Digital Commerce & Customer Experience Lead
cover_en.hook: Polarn O. Pyret's dedication to timeless, sustainable design and a strong digital retail foundation makes this Digital Commerce & Customer Experience Lead role an exceptional fit. Bringing over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, complex API integrations, and robust data flows at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to help elevate your digital ecosystem.

bullets.label: Platform & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), exposing OCC REST Web Services and building seamless data pipelines to synchronize product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: Data Flows & PIM Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between ERP, MDM, and e-commerce platforms to ensure data consistency.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by analyzing needs, authoring user stories and functional specifications, and supporting user acceptance testing with international stakeholders.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Efficiency
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI and LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing, and documentation workflows to accelerate delivery and maintain high solution quality.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical depth and e-commerce expertise can support Polarn O. Pyret.

tailoring.why_company: Polarn O. Pyret combines a rich heritage of sustainable, premium children's retail with a forward-thinking digital strategy. I am eager to bring my expertise in complex platform integrations, data flows, and e-commerce architecture to help optimize your digital ecosystem, ensuring seamless technical performance that empowers the online business and enriches the customer experience.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving digital commerce excellence by combining deep technical architecture, seamless API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to elevate retail experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, complex integrations, and data flows at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to bring my technical expertise to Polarn O. Pyret as your Digital Commerce & Customer Experience Lead. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Digital Commerce & Customer Experience Lead - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Commerce & Customer Experience Lead position at Polarn O. Pyret. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, and optimizing enterprise e-commerce platforms and data flows for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise combined with strong techno-functional delivery.

My tailored cover letter and detailed CV are attached for your review. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your digital team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
